_metadata.purpose: Explicit human overrides applied on top of blind-review verdicts (scripts/unlimited/apply-overrides.mjs). A hint override can hold a passed hint out of the beta, or release such a hold; it never makes a hint playable by itself. A pair override (status hold_pair) keeps a pair out of FUTURE generation only: boards already assembled or served, their snapshots and players' history are never touched.

overrides.reason: held out of the first US beta pending final content review: fish finger is the British term (US: fish sticks); the blind review passed it, so it stays in the library
